fv.mBlend: Blends Chronos-2 and the hybrid model per group. The weight is learned from both models' errors on past days (for this Chronos re-computes every day what it would have forecast the evening before; recent days count more): where Chronos was closer it counts more, otherwise hybrid. Selectable from {from}; until then it only learns.
fv.blendShare: Learned so far: Chronos share {pct} (from {days} days, {n} groups rated).
fv.colChronosTip: Hourly deviation of the Chronos day-ahead forecast (context only up to midnight of the day), over the counted hours
fv.chronosTip: AI time-series model, runs for comparison only; the published forecast is our own. Runs four times a day, values from the latest run.
fv.noneHint: The collector writes forecast/series.json with every forecast run (hourly). Once the first run with the new version has completed, the curve appears here.
fv.famAria: Vehicle family of the forecast (one model per family)
fv.noneFam: There is no forecast for {fam} yet.
fv.noneFamHint: The collector fits a separate model for each vehicle family (forecast/moped/, forecast/car/). It appears once trips of this kind are counted and becomes meaningful after a few full days.
fv.scAllTagTip: One shared model for all groups in Germany: learning progress and model comparison do not depend on the selected area. Per area and operator: panel “Forecast for …”.
fv.scSub: What is expected, how well it has hit so far and what the forecast learns from – per group (operator × vehicle type in one municipality).
fv.scNone: There is no forecast group for this selection.
fv.scNoneHint: Forecasts exist for groups with counted trips; where only the fleet is known (e.g. car sharing without visible bookings), this area stays empty.
fv.scLead: {n} groups, {x} of them with enough own experience for a judgement of their own.
fv.scLead1Ok: enough own experience for a judgement of its own
fv.scLead1Low: not yet enough own experience for a judgement of its own
fv.scPartOwn: for {n} mainly from their own history
fv.scPartPool: for {n} mainly from all other groups
fv.scPartMix: for {n} roughly half from their own history and half from all other groups
fv.scArea: {s} as a whole, plan vs actual over the last {n} days: {a} deviation per hour, “like yesterday” {b} – {v}.
fv.scAreaNone: No hourly series with plan and actual is stored yet for the selection as a whole.
fv.scLearnAll: no self-check yet – overall weight {w} own
fv.scLearnShrunk: little experience: close to the overall weight
fv.scMore: {n} more groups with fewer expected trips not shown.
fv.scQuiet: No forecast of their own because hardly any trips were counted (under {ok}): {list}. These {n} groups learn almost only from the pooled model.
fv.scHowHybrid: Active is {model}: each group's daily level comes from its own trips on the last matching day (shrunk towards the model of all groups by {k} trip starts when there are few trips), the course over the hours half from its own profile and half from the model learned from all groups.
fv.scHowAdaptive: Active is {model}: each group mixes its own profile and the model of all groups as shown in the column “Learns from”.
fv.scHowProfile: Active is {model}: each group predicts from its own history only.
fv.scHowBlend: Active is {model}: per group a mix of Chronos-2 and the hybrid model, weighted by the past errors of both.
fv.scHowPooled: Active is {model}: it learns the daily pattern, weekday and weather from all groups, each group keeps its own level.
fv.scHowNone: No active model yet – too few days.
fv.scHowCols: Next 24 h: expected trip starts. Own experience: trip starts the group could be measured against in the self-check (older days count less; a lot from {much}, enough from {ok}). Error: mean deviation per hour when only the group's own history or only the model learned from all groups predicts. Learns from: share of its own history the learning model derives from that – close to the overall weight with little experience. Plan · like yesterday: published daily forecast against the counted trips per hour, next to the assumption “like yesterday” (only groups with their own hourly series).
fv.learnSub: The model keeps learning and checks itself: each day it is predicted using only data from before that day and is then measured against reality.
fv.stLearning: Learning phase: pooled model for now, {n} of {min} days checked retrospectively.
fv.stInsufficient: No forecast yet: {n} training days, at least {min} needed.
fv.stSmall: No forecast: {n} trip starts per day (7-day mean), modelling starts at {min}.
fv.stSmallWeek: Too little volume for a model ({n} trip starts per day, from {min}): shown is the same weekday last week.
fv.activeFrom: Earliest {date} until it is checked enough to become “active” – one more full day at a time.
fv.gTrainSub: full days the model learns from
fv.gEvalSub: days the model had not seen before and that were then measured against reality
fv.gTempSub: Range of daily means per town (10th–90th percentile); weather is only used once it is wide enough to learn an effect
fv.gRainSub: so far {rain} rain days and {dry} dry days (days with or without rain in at least 10 % of towns); enough of both are needed
fv.wxOn: Weather is part of the forecast (temperature and rain).
fv.wxOff: Weather is not used yet: it only joins once temperature range and rain and dry days are sufficient and it measurably improves the self-check.
fv.chartAhead: Today and tomorrow, hour by hour
fv.chartSub: Expected and counted trip starts per hour (local time)
fv.chartNote: Plan = forecast from the start of the day, never changed afterwards and used as the yardstick. Live forecast = current prediction from the next full hour with the latest weather and fleet. Actuals = counted trip starts; hours without enough observation stay empty. Where no available vehicle stands, no trip can start: forecast and actuals show trips taken, not total demand.
fv.chartAria: Bar chart: trip starts per hour for today and tomorrow, actuals and live forecast, with the plan line; {total} in total
fv.noScope: No series is stored for this selection
fv.noScopeHint: Stored are Germany overall, every operator, every vehicle type, municipalities from 40 and groups (municipality × operator × type) from 80 trip starts per day. Choose a larger cut.
fv.nPartial: The selection is the sum of the stored groups (municipality × operator × type, from 80 trip starts per day); smaller groups are missing, so the sum is slightly below the true value.
fv.nIgnored: Only the municipality total is stored here; the operator and type filters have no effect.
fv.kSoFarSub: plan for the same hours: {plan} (plan {d} against actual)
fv.kNoPlan: no plan for this day yet
fv.kDaySub: plan for the full day {plan} · expectation {d} against plan
fv.accSub: Plan (before the day started, computed from earlier days only) against actuals per hour, the last days
fv.accNoneHint: It needs at least one finished day with a plan and counted trip starts.
fv.accNote: Error = Σ |actual − plan| ÷ Σ actual over all hours with both values (smaller is better). Bias = Σ plan ÷ Σ actual − 1 (negative = plan too low). “Same as yesterday” = the same hour of the previous day as the forecast; lead = 1 − error ÷ error of “same as yesterday” (positive = forecast better). In the first days the model learns from only a few training days, so the error is still high.
fv.raceNote: Rolling origin: each day is predicted using only the days before it and measured afterwards. Score = mean of the error per group and day (level) and per group and hour (daily shape). The active model is the one with the lowest score over the last days; weather only if it noticeably improves the pooled model; the adaptive model and the hybrid only if they clearly beat the chosen one. “Same as yesterday” only runs as a yardstick.
fv.colPinballTip: Pinball loss of the band’s 10 % and 90 % limits per trip start (lower = narrow and still on target). The band adapts per time of day until it covers 80 % of the hours.
fv.dmLocked: locked: {n} of {min} test days for the DM test
fv.decRule: Yardstick: Σ error ÷ Σ error of the better baseline (“same as yesterday” or last week) over the same hours (×1.00 = equally good, lower = better; in the self-check only hours where both baselines have a value). Every published forecast is checked against actuals together with all candidates as shadow forecasts. From {min} live forecasts on, live counts with the weight n ÷ (n + {k}) (recent ones more, half-life {hl} days), before that the self-check alone. A switch needs a lead of {gain} over the current model, at most once in 7 days (unless the lead is 10 %). Chronos-2 and the blend become selectable only once a Diebold-Mariano test over at least 14 days shows a lead with p < 0.10. If after {base} live forecasts no model beats the yardsticks, the better yardstick is published. Peak columns: live, Germany total and per operator.
fv.spotsTitle: Deploy and parking spots: importance and shortfall
fv.spotsSub: Known deploy spots (operator drop-offs) and parking spots (feed) of the municipality, rated by measured demand nearby and by the forecast: how important the spot is, how many vehicles should be there and how many are.
fv.spotsPickHint: The spot rating is computed per municipality and operator. Pick a municipality in the filter above or tap one of the strongest municipalities for tomorrow.
fv.spotsNoFleet: No fleet data for the federal state
fv.spotsNoFleetHint: The fleet file of the federal state under ops/ is missing or unreadable.
fv.spotsNoOp: No vehicles or stations are recorded in this municipality.
fv.spotsNone: No deploy or parking spots are known for {op} in this municipality.
fv.spotsLead: {op}: {spots} known spots; according to the forecast {miss} vehicles are missing in total, spread over {nMiss} spots, {imp} of them at important spots (class A and B).
fv.mapAria: Map of the rated spots; size = importance, colour = shortfall
fv.nPrelim: Preliminary: demand is based on only {h} observed hours so far.
fv.nNoFc: No forecast for this operator in the municipality: target from measured demand only.
fv.nNoDemand: No measured demand for this municipality: all spots are class D.
fv.spotsNote: Method: the demand of each spot is the share of its cell ({CELL}) in the municipality's measured demand, distributed over the operator's forecast (assumption: the operator is spread spatially like the market). Target = vehicles that should be on site for the expected trip starts of the next {h} hours; actual = available vehicles of the operator within {r} m. Importance = demand ÷ highest demand (A from 50 %, B from 20 %, C below, D without measurement).
fv.gRowLive: Issued forecasts: per operator and hour
fv.gRowLiveSub: Live check of the published forecasts, {n} forecasts, {h} observed hours on average
fv.liveNote: The observed hours are evaluated (at least {min} of 24); hours with a gap in the collector do not count. “Same as yesterday” = the latest same hour that was already over when the forecast was issued (fair: nothing the forecast could not have known; until 6 Nov 2026 the day before the target hour, often not yet available for the evening), previous week = same weekday 7 days earlier. Since 6 Nov 2026 evening: error of the published model over the same hours as the yardsticks; 80 % band = share of operator-hours inside the stated range.
fv.partsTitle: By vehicle type and group size
fv.partsNote: Last checked day ({d}), “{model}” against “same as yesterday”: error per group and day · per group and hour. The overall score is weighted by trip starts – here you can see how individual types and small groups fare.
fv.kvExpoSub: Vehicle hours per group and hour on {d}: assumption “as last observed” against actual (plan and forecast use the assumption)
fv.kvExpoAlt: Logged for comparison: last day of the same day type {c}, mean of the last three {m}.
fv.kvExpoNone: not measured yet (from the next self-check)
fv.pMinEvalTrain: Checked days only count in the model choice from this many training days
fv.pLiveMin: Live check: this many of the 24 hours must be observed
fv.pWxShare: Weather gate: share of towns with or without rain from which a day counts as a rain or dry day
fv.gradeSub: How far off the forecast is – and whether it beats the simplest assumption, “same as yesterday”. Forecasts are observed trip starts with the fleet that is there, not unmet demand: where no vehicle stands, nobody can start a trip.
fv.vNone: No verdict yet: there is no day with a forecast, actuals and a previous day to compare against.
fv.vAll: Better than “same as yesterday” – on all {n} levels.
fv.vOne: Better than “same as yesterday”: {a} against {b} error per hour.
fv.vOneEq: Level with “same as yesterday”: {a} against {b} error per hour.
fv.vOneWorse: Not yet better than “same as yesterday”: {a} against {b} error per hour.
fv.vUnusable: Not usable yet: {a} error per hour (“same as yesterday” {b}) – read only as an order of magnitude.
fv.vNational: The verdict is for Germany as a whole; there is no comparison for the selection yet.
fv.normTip: The collector runs about every 18 minutes, so an hour contains 3 or 4 runs (50–76 minutes). “Per full hour” rescales to 60 minutes.
fv.normNote: Hourly values rescaled to 60 observed minutes (otherwise a saw-tooth from 3 or 4 runs per hour); totals and tiles stay counted values.
fv.usualTip: Range of the counted values for the same hour on the last up to 3 days of the same kind (weekday, Saturday, Sunday/holiday)
fv.staleDay: Forecast as of {time}. The first run of the new day is still pending – the days below are labelled by date.
fv.vNoWorse: Better than or level with “same as yesterday” ({b} of {n} levels better).
fv.vNotYet: Not yet better than “same as yesterday” ({w} of {n} levels worse).
fv.vMixed: Mixed: better than “same as yesterday” on {b} of {n} levels, worse on {w}.
fv.vBasisEarly: Basis: only {n} checked days (fully reliable from {win}) – the verdict is provisional.
fv.vBiasLow: On average the forecast was {d} too low.
fv.vBiasHigh: On average the forecast was {d} too high.
fv.vBiasNone: No clear lean towards too high or too low ({d}).
fv.gRowScopeSub: Daily plan against actuals, mean over {n} days
fv.gRowGroupSub: Town × operator × vehicle type, self-check of “{model}”, mean over {n} days
fv.gHow: How to read it: error = how far off the forecast is on average, as a percentage of the actual trip starts (0 % would be perfect). “Same as yesterday” is the simplest possible forecast: the same hour of the previous day. If the model does not beat it, it adds nothing (yet). Level = less than 5 % apart.
fv.dlNote: The fact sheet describes method, formula, selection rule, all parameters, the learning state and the daily self-check with current figures (Markdown in the chosen language; plan against actuals for the current selection). The engine is plain JavaScript without third-party packages (Node 18 or later, or a browser) and needs the four helper files in the same folder. Called by the collector (scripts/collect.mjs): runForecast({ docs, calendar, weather, incidents, curated, prevLog, prevSeries, now }). Everything is also in the repository: {repo}
fv.curveSub: Score per day in the self-check: each day is predicted using only the days before it and measured afterwards. If the line falls, the model is learning.
fv.curveAria: Learning curve: score per day and model
fv.curveOne: Only one checked day so far – the learning curve grows with every further day.
fv.curveTrend: “{model}”: score {a} on {d1} ({t1} training days) → {b} on {d2} ({t2} training days).
fv.learnedTitle: What the adaptive model has learned from its errors
fv.learnedNone: No learning state yet: it is built from the checked days at the next forecast run.
fv.learnedLead: From {days} days of its own errors (older ones count less): of {judged} groups with enough trips, {own} rely mainly on their own history, {pool} mainly on all others, {mixed} on both. Overall hourly error: own profile {eo}, pooled {ep}; on average the own profile counts for {share}.
fv.learnedActive: It is active and produces the forecast.
fv.learnedCandidate: It runs as a candidate and becomes active once it beats the chosen model in the self-check by at least {gain}.
fv.learnedNote: Weight of own profile: 100 % = the group relies entirely on its own history, 0 % = entirely on the model learned from all groups. Error = error per group and hour in the self-check (older days fade). Groups with little experience get the overall weight.
fv.mAdaptive: Learns from its own errors: per group a mix of its own profile and the pooled model. The weight comes from the group's track record in the self-check (older days fade, half-life {hl} days): where its own history hit better, it counts more; where it hit worse or is missing, the group learns from all others.
fv.mHybrid: Combines what fits best on its own: each group's daily level comes from the last complete day of the same day type (at most {back} days back, otherwise the last complete day), the shape across the hours from the model (mean of own profile and pooled model). Small groups are shrunk towards the model with {k} trip starts. It follows a seasonal drop or fleet change quickly; it does not take over the weather effect on the daily level.
fv.evSub: Home matches (Bundesliga 1 and 2, selected 3. Liga, DEL, DFB Cup, Champions League) and dates at venues from 5,000 seats and the curated list, 7 days back to as far ahead as selected, in the selected area
fv.evNone: No events in the selected area and period.
fv.evNote: Seats = venue capacity according to Wikidata, not tickets sold. Sources: OpenLigaDB (ODbL), Wikidata (CC0), the venues' programme pages (each date linked). Events enter the forecast from {from} (feature “event”, one hour before the start to 3 hours after; without a time 17–23, multi-day 10–22).
fv.evMainSub: What is coming up, what happened recently and how much it moved trips
fv.evNextBig: Coming up: large dates in the next 7 days
fv.evNoneNext: No recorded events in the next 14 days.
fv.evNonePast: No recorded events in the last 7 days.
fv.evColEffTip: Trip starts in the time window against the day's plan, adjusted for the deviation in the remaining hours
fv.evEffTip: Actual {ist} against plan {plan} in {h} hours ({rel}); remaining hours of the day {rest}
fv.evMainNote: All dates are recorded and marked in the hourly chart. They enter the forecast from {d} (end of the learning phase), then retroactively for every day in the training window.
fv.evEffAll: Measured effect across all cities, last 8 days (median, adjusted for the rest of the day): {list}.
fv.evAutoN: Detected automatically: {n} entries – strikes from the tagesschau app news search (hourly, effective immediately) and dates from the official pages of fairs, trade fairs, stadiums and festivals (weekly in the “Termine” workflow, rules plus a small local language model; each date linked).
fv.envSub: Weather, severe weather warnings, motorway, strikes and events: what the forecast has learned from them and how much experience is behind it. What it learned is kept beyond the 21-day window.
fv.env.road: motorway: closure or jam in town
fv.env.rain1: rain from 1 mm/h (on top of the rainy hour)
fv.envLead: Memory since {since}: {days} days of experience, {old} of them already outside the 21-day window (older days count less, half-life {hl} days). Effect = factor on the expected trip starts (×1.00 = none).
fv.envSources: Warnings last fetched: {warn} · motorway: {road} · event list: {n} entries.
fv.envNote: An influence enters the model once it occurred in at least {rows} town-hours on {days} days; then the model with environment must score better in the self-check than without. The collector detects strikes hourly from the tagesschau app news search (date and place required, link per report); strikes and events from the curated list data/ereignisse.json (with source) are added.
fv.pCtxRows: Environment: town-hours with an event an influence needs before it may enter the model
fv.pCtxDays: Environment: on this many different days
fv.pMemHl: Long-term memory: half-life in days (older experience counts less)
fv.pTypeHour: Pooled: own daily shape per vehicle type (e-scooter, bike, e-bike, cargo bike)
fv.pHier: Pooled: the level of a group with little data starts at the same operator and type in other towns
fv.pHalfLife7: Pooled and profile: half-life in days by which older days in the 21-day window count less
fv.aEnvHow: Severe weather warnings from DWD (via Bright Sky, per 0.5° weather cell, with start and end, so also for the coming hours), closures and jams on motorways within the town (Autobahn GmbH, only for the observed hour), strikes automatically from the tagesschau app news search and from the curated list, events from the curated list, OpenLigaDB and the venues' programme pages. Only flags per town and hour are stored.
fv.aMemHow: Every completed day leaves its information about weather and environment effects; once it leaves the 21-day window, it becomes prior knowledge of the model (half-life {hl} days). No day counts twice.
fv.aWeight: Weight of own profile per group
fv.aWeightHow: Learned from the group's errors in the self-check (own profile against the pooled model, per hour), half-life {hl} days; groups with little experience get the overall weight. Only used when the adaptive model is active.
fv.pAdGain: Improvement the adaptive model or the hybrid needs over the chosen one
fv.pHalfLife: Half-life of the learning state in days (older errors count less)
fv.pKBlend: Shrinkage: trip starts of experience a group needs before its own record counts
fv.pSharp: Sharpness of the weighting (2 = inverse squared error, Bates–Granger)
fv.pHybK: Hybrid: shrinkage in trip starts (small groups stay closer to the model)
fv.pHybBack: Hybrid: at most this many days back for a reference day of the same day type
fv.mdWhatTxt: Trip starts per hour for every group of town × operator × vehicle type (currently {g} groups in {m} towns), computed from open sharing data without operator access. Horizon: from the next full hour to the end of tomorrow; plus a daily plan that is frozen at the first run of the day and then measured against actuals.
fv.mdActive: Active: {model}. Reason given by the collector: {reason}
fv.mdLearn: How the forecast learns from its errors
fv.mdCodeTxt: Engine: lib/pulse-forecast.js; needs lib/pulse-econ.js, lib/pulse-track.js and lib/pulse-core.js. Called by the collector: scripts/collect.mjs (block “Prognose”). Raw data in the data branch: forecast/latest.json, forecast/log.json (with the learning state “feedback”), forecast/series.json. Repository: {repo}
fv.filterHint: Change the selection in the filter bar above.
fv.moreBasis: How this is calculated, and what is measured or assumed, is described under
fv.checksSub: What the forecast checks about itself – each line with its reason from the current data.
fv.cFreshNone: The series file states no time.
fv.cFreshWhy: Last written {time}, {h} h ago. The collector writes them with every forecast run, at most hourly.
fv.cEvalWhy: {n} of {min} days checked retroactively; until then the model choice is provisional.
fv.cNaiveBad: “{model}”: score {a}, “same as yesterday” {n}. Normal while learning, a warning sign later.
fv.cNaiveNone: No evaluation against the previous day yet.
fv.cBestBad: In the self-check “{best}” leads ({b}); “{act}” is active ({a}). The choice only becomes binding after {min} checked days.
fv.cWxOff: Off: temperature range {range} of {need} K, rain days {rain}, dry days {dry} (at least {n} each), missing weather share {miss}.
fv.cExclNone: No group excluded for implausible counts.
fv.cExclWhy: {n} groups are left out of training and forecast because the plausibility check rates their counts red.
fv.cPlanNone: There is no plan for today (too little data at the first run of the day).
fv.cPlanOld: The series file does not yet store the plan's origin (older state); it arrives with the next collector run.
fv.cLiveWhy: {n} issued forecasts have been compared with reality (over the observed hours).
fv.cLiveNone: No issued forecast has been evaluated yet: this happens once its 24 hours are over and at least 16 of them were observed.
fv.inSub: What the model currently works with – from forecast/latest.json, log.json and series.json.
fv.kvTrainSub: fully observed days; hours with too little observation do not count
fv.kvGroupsSub: municipality × operator × vehicle type, in {m} municipalities
fv.kvPhiSub: variance ≈ φ × expectation; sets the 80 % band
fv.kvFairNone: from the next evaluated day: only hours with a previous-day value, as in the live comparison
fv.kvFairSub: {model} {a} against “same as yesterday” {b} per hour, only hours with a previous-day value, {n} days; current self-check {raw} × (counts missing hours as 0). Intended as the basis of model choice from 28 Nov.
fv.pmSub: The daily re-learned demand model as a file and a script – for your own fleet, also as a new operator
fv.pmNone: No model file for this vehicle family yet (it is written on the next forecast run once a forecast is active).
fv.pmLead: As of {at}, learned from {n} days of open data: trip starts per available vehicle and hour by time of day, day type (weekday, school holidays, Saturday, Sunday/holiday), vehicle type ({types}), weather and events – plus the level of {ops} operator types and an adjustment for {cities} municipalities. Your own counts recalibrate the level (script option --zaehlung).
fv.pmLevelTypSub: from all operators of this type, weighted by vehicle hours
fv.pmOpMissing: {op} with this type is not in the model
fv.pmNote: Calculated without weather and events; the script adds the DWD forecast and your own events. The 80 % band in the script only contains counting noise (φ {phi}); the actual error per operator and hour was recently 15–25 %. Licence: attribution, share-alike for CC-BY-SA sources.
fv.kvWxOff: not in the model: range {range} K, {rain} rain days, {dry} dry days, {miss} without weather
fv.kvHorizonSub: from {time}; live series to the end of {d}
fv.provNote: A plan is computed at the first run of the day and stays unchanged afterwards; retroactively computed plans only use days before the day in question. ⚑ = deviation above 25 %: not explained by the model, possible causes under “Not taken into account”.
fv.oddTip: Deviation above 25 % – a possible cause is not covered by the model
fv.modelSub: Poisson regression across all groups together (“pooled”), relearned every day – plus an adaptive model that weights each group by its own errors, and a hybrid with yesterday's level. Pooled, profile and the adaptive model are corrected per vehicle type and municipality for their bias over the last 7 checked days (shrunk, at most ±25 %), the plan and the live forecast alike.
fv.formula:
Trip starts per group and hour ~ Poisson(μ)
log μ = log(vehicle hours) + a[group] + hour[24] + day type × hour + vehicle type × hour + counting rule + weather (cold, warm, rain) + environment (warning, motorway, strike, rail strike, event)
a[group] shrunk towards operator × type; days weighted by 2^(−age/7 days)
weather and environment effects: prior knowledge from the long-term memory (days outside the window)
adaptive: forecast = w[group] × own profile + (1 − w[group]) × pooled, w from the group's own errors
hybrid: forecast = base × (trip starts on the reference day + k) ÷ (base for the same hours + k), base = ½ profile + ½ pooled
fv.mProfile: Own hourly profile per group and day type, no sharing between groups (recent days count more); strong with a long history, weak for small groups.
fv.mPooled: All groups together: shared weekly shape, daily shape per vehicle type, only the level per group is its own – with little data close to the level of the same operator and type in other towns; recent days count more. Copes with small and new groups too. Since 13 Nov 2026 it works per full hour (trip starts and vehicles scaled to 60 observed minutes, so the collector rhythm of 3 or 4 runs per hour no longer shows) and Saturday and Sunday/holiday share a weekend daily shape (if a day type lacks an hour, the weekend applies instead of the weekday).
fv.mPooledWx: As pooled, plus temperature (cold/warm) and rain once the weather gate is open, and environment events (severe weather warning, motorway, strike, event) once there are enough cases; the effects start from the long-term memory. Chosen only when the self-check measurably improves.
fv.mNaive: Benchmark, not selectable: same group and hour on the previous day.
fv.mChronos: AI time-series model by Amazon (Chronos-2, Apache 2.0), pretrained on many other time series, no training of its own. Four times a day it forecasts the next 48 hours for each group with at least {min} trips in 7 days, using vehicle hours, weather, day type and hour of day; smaller groups take the hybrid model's value. It is never published on its own; it feeds in through the blend.
fv.chooseRule: Choice: the model with the lowest score over the last {win} days (score = mean of the error per group and day and per group and hour); the weather model only if it is at least {gain} better than pooled; the adaptive model and the hybrid only if they beat the model chosen this way by at least {again} over the same days (if both do, the larger lead). Only checked days with at least {mt} training days count; a choice needs {min} such days, until then pooled applies provisionally. “Same as yesterday” and previous week are yardsticks; they are published only if no model beats them live (see “Which forecast is published?”).
fv.assumeSub: Every quantity that goes into or comes out of the forecast and the spot rating – and how solid it is.
fv.aStarts: Trip starts per group and hour (the “actual”)
fv.aStartsHow: Derived from snapshots of the open feeds (vehicle was there, is gone), not reported by the operator. Hours with too little observation do not count; groups rated red by the plausibility check are left out.
fv.aExposureHow: Counted from the same snapshots; the model works in trip starts per vehicle hour.
fv.aDayType: Day type: weekday, school holidays, Saturday, Sunday and public holiday
fv.aDayTypeHow: Calendar of the OpenHolidays API per federal state; without it a built-in holiday calculation. Local holidays and bridge days are missing.
fv.aWeatherHow: DWD data via Bright Sky, one value per 0.5° grid cell and municipality; used only when the weather gate is open. The forecast values come from the same service.
fv.aEraHow: If the counting or checking rule of the evaluation changes, the change is detected so it is not learned as a demand change; the forecast uses the current version.
fv.aPlanHow: Model output. The plan is computed at the first run of the day and stays frozen; the live forecast is recomputed hourly. Both are expectations, not measurements.
fv.aBandHow: From the dispersion φ of the counts. It means: in about 8 of 10 hours the counted value should lie inside the band, in 2 of 10 above or below it – the band is not a hard limit. How often it actually hits is in the model table (column “80 % band hit”, 70 % = in 7 of 10 hours).
fv.bandFreq: 80 % band: the counted value should lie inside the band in about 8 of 10 operator-hours; in the latest scored forecast it did in {k} of 10.
fv.aDeployHow: Assumed: places where the fleet repeatedly jumps up (service vehicles dropping vehicles). No operator data; the position is only accurate to a few hundred metres.
fv.aParkHow: Stations and virtual spots the operator reports in the open feed. What the feed does not report is missing here, even if the operator knows it.
fv.aDemandHow: Share of the grid cell ({CELL}) in the municipality's trip starts over the last days (all operators); several places in one cell share it equally.
fv.aShare: Assumption: the operator is spread spatially like the market
fv.aShareHow: Open data only knows the spatial distribution of demand for all operators together. Expectation per place = cell share × the operator's forecast in the municipality. An operator with a different focus is therefore distributed wrongly.
fv.aTargetHow: Rule, not a measurement: trip starts of {base} h as base stock, at least {min}, at most {max} vehicles, plus the measured net outflow of the next {h} hours; using the forecast instead of measured starts.
fv.aHaveHow: Measured: available vehicles of the operator within {r} m (feed snapshot); each vehicle counts only at the nearest place. The reported stock of physical stations takes precedence.
fv.aMissingHow: Target minus actual, never negative. With many small places and a minimum stock the sum gets large; “important” counts classes A and B only.
fv.aClassesHow: Fixed thresholds: A from {a}, B from {b} of the list's highest expectation, C below, D = no measured demand at the place.
fv.lastSpots: Last rated: {m}, {op} – {n} places ({d} deploy, {p} parking, {b} both).
fv.paramSub: Fixed in the code (lib/), not adjustable in the dashboard. Changes only apply with a new version of the page.
fv.pMinEval: Checked days from which a model choice applies
fv.pHourMin: Minutes of observation per hour; below it the hour does not count
fv.pWxRange: Range of daily means per town (10th–90th percentile, K) the weather gate requires
fv.pWxRain: Rain and dry days (rain or no rain in ≥ 10 % of towns), at least each
fv.pWxMiss: Highest share of rows without weather
fv.pWxGain: Improvement over pooled that the weather model needs to be chosen
fv.pSerAgs: Municipality series from this many planned trip starts per day
fv.pSerGroup: Group series from this many planned trip starts per day
fv.pSerMax: At most this many group series
fv.pBase: Base stock per spot in hours of trip starts
fv.pRadius: Radius of a spot in m within which vehicles count
fv.pPrelim: Measured hours after which net outflow and stability are no longer provisional
fv.pClassA: Class A from this share of the highest expectation
fv.pLink: Deploy and parking spot within this distance (m) count as one place
fv.pDemandDays: Days of the cell demand model
fv.nTrainHow: Collected since 12 Nov 2026 from the free gtfs.de real-time feed (CC BY-SA 4.0): stops with real-time data, cancelled and delayed stops per municipality and hour, not yet used by the forecast. Coverage has gaps (buses in NRW and BW incomplete, Hamburg missing). Rail strikes work through the event list and the strike detection.
fv.nStrikeHow: The collector detects strikes automatically from news (streiks.json) and feeds them into the model immediately; what does not appear there is missing.
fv.nEventsHow: Captured: home matches (OpenLigaDB), dates at venues from 5,000 seats and programme pages (“Termine” workflow), curated list. Effective from 28 Nov; smaller venues and fairs without a programme page are missing.
fv.nRoadHow: Motorways nationwide (Autobahn GmbH). In towns, new full closures in Baden-Württemberg (MobiData BW), Hamburg and Munich have been collected hourly since 11 Nov 2026, not yet used by the forecast. Other towns have no open source; congestion is missing entirely.
fv.nOpHow: Since 11 Nov, daily from our own data: price changes (tariff feeds), fleet jumps (≥ 25 % against previous days), feed outages (hours without vehicles). Stored in eingriffe.json and the training archive, not yet used by the model. Promotions (free minutes, vouchers) are not in any feed.
fv.nZonesHow: Since 11 Nov: changes to the zone feeds (geofencing_zones) per source and day (zones-log.json), not yet used by the model.
fv.opsLead: For the selection: {list}. Collected for training and checks, not in the forecast.
fv.opsNone: No eingriffe.json yet (written on the next collector run).
fv.opsMore: … and {n} more (eingriffe.json in the data branch).
fv.opsFleet: fleet {from} → {to} ({d} against the median of previous days)
fv.opsOutage: {h} h almost without vehicles in the feed (otherwise ≈ {fleet})
fv.notSub: What influences demand but does not (yet) enter the model – and how far it is already captured. Such days show up as unexplained deviation between plan and actual.
fv.nStrike: Strikes that are neither in the event list nor detected in the news
fv.nTrain: Train and line cancellations, disruptions in public transport
fv.nEvents: Match days, fairs and concerts as long as they are not entered
fv.nWarn: Storm and heat warnings (weather enters only as temperature and rain)
fv.nRoad: Closures, roadworks and congestion in town
fv.nOp: Operator actions: promotions, price changes, fleet changes, service interruptions
fv.nZones: Changes to no-ride and operating zones
fv.notNote: The model does not learn these influences (weather, severe weather warnings, motorway and listed strikes it does, see “Environment and long-term memory”). A striking deviation (⚑ in “Origin of the plans”) is a hint to look for such a cause, not proof.
fv.rawSub: The collector's files this view is computed from.
fv.rawNote: latest: forecast of the next 24 hours per group and self-check · log: checked days and issued forecasts · series: hourly series per area for the dashboard.
